messages:
mei: Heads up — onboarding tests showed inconsistent rerank after swapping to the new embeddings model. Some ranks reversed, others duplicated. Error seen: `EmbeddingDimError: expected 1024 got 2048`

jon: which SDKs were in the path?

mei: Kotlin sampleapp (ok), dotnet retriever (bad), and our legacy python retriever (also weird). dotnet SDK returns `vectors.values` (nested) and python returns base64-encoded bytes for embeddings in one of the older branches. kotlin uses `embedding` array.

pat: wait nested `vectors.values`? example?

mei: snippet from dotnet raw response (redacted):
```json
{"id":"u1","vectors": {"values": [0.001, 0.002, ...(2048 nums)...]}, "model":"gen-2048"}
```
python branch was decoding base64 to 2048 floats but sampleapp expected 1024. dotnet retriever's batcher quietly truncated to 1024 during retry-merge which produced skewed cosine scores. python retry path produced duplicate candidates because retry was treated as separate insertion.

ci-bot: [1756789015] 401 Unauthorized POST /v1/embeddings req=token-99
ci-bot: [1756789016] token refresh succeeded
ci-bot: [1756789017] retry /v1/embeddings req=token-99 -> 200

jon: so three things collided: 1) response shape differences (embedding vs vectors.values vs base64), 2) dim change (1024->2048), 3) retry merge semantics differ across SDKs.

pat: mitigation checklist: a) canonicalize SDK parsing so all clients expose resp.data[i].embedding as float[] (SDK layer handles nested/base64), b) batcher should preserve raw payloads until dim validation step (no silent truncation), c) require Idempotency-Key for retries and treat retried requests as idempotent in batch merge stage, d) add opt-in STRICT_EMBED_DIM env var to fail-fast.

mei: I'll update onboarding sampleapp (Kotlin) to set EXPECTED_DIM and inject Idempotency-Key on retries. i'll also add a short note about transient 401s causing retry merges.

jon: I'll change dotnet retriever: map vectors.values -> embedding in parser and defer any pad/truncate logic until after validation. PR incoming.

pat: I'll patch python branch to decode base64 in SDK layer and add strict-dim unit test. Also add dedupe at ingestion for retried request ids.

mei: quick workaround for teams:
```kotlin
val e = resp.data[0].embedding ?: resp.data[0].vectors?.values
if (e.size != CONFIG.EXPECTED_DIM) throw RuntimeException("bad dim ${'$'}{e.size}")
client.defaultHeaders["Idempotency-Key"] = requestId
```

jon: opened PRs: github.com/redwood-inference/retriever-dotnet/pull/22 (map-vectors-values); github.com/redwood-inference/sample-apps/pull/317 (kotlin: strict-dim + idempotency).

ci-bot: [1756789035] CI for dotnet PR passed (3/3)

pat: filed platform issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/issues/4410 label=devex/embeddings. adding cross-SDK tests for field shapes, base64 handling, and retry merge flows.

mei: thanks all. will update onboarding docs and sampleapps README with EXPECTED_DIM guidance + idempotency recommendation. moving to follow-up. :thumbsup:
